name: Sprig & Barrow
oneLiner: The corner greengrocer — picked before dawn, priced by the kilo, gone by six.
paletteSeed: produce colour worlds — one family per section: market-paper cream → tomato vermilion → citrus amber → chard green → plum dusk; chalk white annotations carry the stall's voice throughout
typeDirection: Fraunces variable (soft wonky display serif, market-poster warmth; italic = chalk voice) + Work Sans (body) — both OFL, vendored
motionBudget: one deterministic gravity: the day's crate empties as you scroll — drawn produce falls past the viewport, position/rotation pure functions of scroll progress with per-item variance (no engine, no collisions, scroll up and it all flies back); the kilo-scale instrument swings its needle on interaction; reduced-motion/no-JS = the full shelf resting in the hero, complete content
port: generic re-design of the gitignored client grocer instantiation (client copy untouched); simulation physics deliberately replaced with scroll-driven kinematics
